name: Springwood Infant School

areas.summary: Moderate publicly visible evidence for curriculum (3 specific items). Listed provision includes mathematics.

signals.text: To improve attainment in reading, writing, mathematics and the wider curriculum so that outcomes for targeted SEND pupils meet Age Related Expectations Children with Cognition and Learning as their Primary Need, at least one year's progress is made in every strand.
Quality First Teaching: • 1:1 word reading • Targeted reading, writing and maths support from pupil progress reviews.
